name: DEMPDHPCA
summary: UCD0120, also known as dides-B,C-LSD or as 1-deaza-2,3,4-trinor-LSD, is a psychedelic drug and a cyclized phenethylamine and simplified or partial ergoline that is structurally related to lysergic acid diethylamide (LSD). It is the analogue of LSD in which the carbon and nitrogen atoms at positions 1 through 4 of the ergoline ring system have been removed.
